books.title: Worth the Weight
books.shortDescription: Anisa’s journey through love, purpose, self-worth, and the courage to return to her true passion.
books.description:
Anisa loves to sing, but she hates being fat. It doesn’t help that the first boy she ever liked as a child rejected her because of her weight. That’s why she can’t find the courage to get on stage, and her journey to love hasn’t been easy.

When an escape to D.C. for Homecoming weekend brings someone unexpected into her life, Anisa must decide whether to keep playing it safe or find the courage to return to her true passion.

books.title: The Love Enthusiast
books.category: A Love Like No Other, book two
books.shortDescription: A poignant story of resilience, forgiveness, family secrets, and a woman determined to love.
books.description:
Amina ‘Badass’ Thompkins is a woman who defies time and embraces love with an unwavering spirit. In her fifties, she remains a timeless beauty, as a singer with an enchanting voice that captivates audiences, though she shies away from the limelight.

To find true happiness, Amina must confront family secrets, the ghosts of her past, and the healing power of forgiveness.
